history.summary: A 1,163 sqft freehold 3BR at Guillemard View (D14, 1994) at $1.8M / $1,548 PSF — but the URA median for the project is just $1,256 PSF, putting this listing ~23% above the project's transacted norm. The strong 5.54%/yr appreciation rests on only 6 transactions, and score_1000 is a very low 309.
history.rating_rationale: The listing's $1,548 PSF is roughly 23% above the $1,256 URA project median — a clear overprice flag, which is why score_1000 collapses to 309 despite a respectable elo. The headline 5.54%/yr appreciation is built on only 6 txns (unreliable), and the development is a 1994 (32-year-old) freehold with aging fundamentals. 730m to Dakota MRT is fine, but paying a 23% premium to the project's own transactions over a 5-7yr hold is poor value.
